description: Chatroom mod: forwards what each room agent does to the room's viewer, writes the roster by itself, and adds /stanza, a pane with the room in the terminal.

hooks.command: python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/share.py" --ensure-cloudflared-background || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/share.py" --ensure-cloudflared-background || uv run --no-project --python 3.14 python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/share.py" --ensure-cloudflared-background || true

in=$(cat); [[ $in =~ \"agent_id\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"([A-Za-z0-9]+)\" ]] || exit 0; r="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/chatroom"; grep -qsF "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" "$r/known_rooms.json" "$r/rooms.json" || exit 0; py=$(command -v python || command -v python3) && printf '%s' "$in" | "$py" -S -E "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/fit.py"

in=$(cat); [[ $in =~ \"agent_id\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"([A-Za-z0-9]+)\" ]] || exit 0; r="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/chatroom"; grep -qsF "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" "$r/known_rooms.json" "$r/rooms.json" || exit 0; py=$(command -v python || command -v python3) && printf '%s' "$in" | "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hold.py"

in=$(cat); [[ $in =~ \"agent_id\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"([A-Za-z0-9]+)\" ]] || exit 0; r="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/chatroom"; grep -qsF "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" "$r/known_rooms.json" "$r/rooms.json" || exit 0; py=$(command -v python || command -v python3) && printf '%s' "$in" | "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hold.py"

in=$(cat); case "$in" in *thumbs*) ;; *) [ ${#in} -le 32000 ] && exit 0;; esac; py=$(command -v python || command -v python3) && printf '%s' "$in" | "$py" -S -E "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/squeeze.py"
